o: Recall the essential ideas of sound and compression.
c: An analogue sound wave is sampled at regular time intervals, and each sample is quantised to an available binary level.
Sample rate counts samples taken per second. More samples can capture changes in the wave more accurately.
Bit depth controls possible amplitude levels. Uncompressed mono size in bits = sample rate × duration × bit depth.
Lossless methods reconstruct original data exactly; lossy methods discard some information to achieve smaller files.
